**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what went wrong, including the error message or traceback if there is one.

**Minimal working example**
A short, self-contained script that reproduces the problem. This is the single most useful thing you can
provide — issues without one are much slower to act on.

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen instead.
